Arosa Silva Review

Review of Arosa Silva

A-Rosa Silva cruises on the Danube, Rhine, and Moselle rivers, departing from ports in Austria, Germany, Hungary, and Romania. The riverboat entered service in 2012 and, like all A-Rosa fleetmates, offers all-inclusive cruisetour packages. Silva’s sister ship is A-Rosa Flora.

Cabins

A-Rosa Silva has a total of 91 cabins, including 6 Suites, 54 with French Balconies, and 29 with one or two non-opening windows, across 4 categories. She is built to the line’s newest design, with the most notable difference being the inclusion of six suites in addition to the standard cabin configurations.

Shipboard Facilities

A-Rosa Silva’s dining and lounge venues include: Market Restaurant (main dining room), Silva Bar, Café Restaurant (casual dining and Afternoon Tea), Wine Bar (regional specialties), Silva Lounge & Bar (entertainment venue), and the Sun Deck with bar/grill stations, a pool, shaded observation area, giant chess, and putting green. The Silva Atrium serves as the ship’s lobby area.

The main restaurant is located on Deck Three, adjacent to the Lounge, and offers Mediterranean cuisine with a continental European influence. Signature onboard amenities include an indoor spa (with two saunas, steam room, a spacious gym, and salon), the new Suite-category staterooms, and an open-air swimming pool on the Sun Deck.

A-Rosa Silva cruise packages include Wi-Fi Internet, all shore excursions (including by bicycle), motorcoach transfers, live onboard entertainment (local performers and enrichment lectures), food and wine tastings, alcoholic beverages (beer, wine, spirits), 24-hour coffee and tea, and daily replenished bottled water.

River cruise fares are per person, based on double occupancy. Listed prices are indicative and may vary depending on promotions, group bookings, travel agency offers, or last-minute discounts.

River Cruise Itineraries

  • 7-day “RHINE NORTH” – Belgium and Holland cruise from Cologne, Germany (round-trip).
  • 7-day “RHINE METROPOLISES AND SEA” – modified Holland and Belgium itinerary from Cologne (round-trip), including lake cruising on IJsselmeer and Markermeer.
  • 7-day “Danube Christmas Markets Cruise” – from Passau (round-trip), with visits to Passau, Bratislava, Budapest (overnight), Esztergom, Vienna (overnight), and Melk.
  • 7-day “DANUBE CLASSICS” – from Passau (round-trip), visiting Vienna (overnight), Esztergom, Budapest (overnight), Bratislava, Krems, cruising through Wachau Valley, and Melk.
  • Two “Black Sea” Danube Delta cruises – 10-day from Passau to Bucharest and 11-day reverse from Bucharest to Passau.
  • Typical departure times: from Cologne and Frankfurt at 5 PM, Passau at 4 or 4:30 PM, and Bucharest at 8 PM.

The A-Rosa Silva itinerary program includes the following voyages from Germany, Austria, and Romania:

  • 4-day Rhine cruise to Belgium and Holland – round-trip from Cologne to Antwerp (overnight), Amsterdam, Düsseldorf
  • 4-day Rhine cruise in Germany – round-trip from Cologne to Worms, Mannheim, Kehl (Strasbourg), Mainz, Loreley Rock passage
  • 4-day Rhine cruise to Holland – round-trip from Cologne to Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Nijmegen
  • 5-day Rhine cruise to Holland and Belgium – round-trip from Cologne to Antwerp (overnight), Amsterdam, Düsseldorf
  • 5-day Moselle River cruise in Germany – round-trip from Cologne to Koblenz, Loreley Rock passage, Mannheim, Speyer, Kehl (Strasbourg), Mainz
  • 7-day Rhine cruise to Holland and Belgium – round-trip from Cologne to IJsselmeer, Hoorn, Amsterdam, Rotterdam (overnight, harbor tour), Ghent, Terneuzen, Scheldt River cruising, Antwerp (overnight), Arnhem
  • 7-day Main River cruise – from Passau to Cologne via Regensburg, Nuremberg, Bamberg, Würzburg, Wertheim, and Frankfurt
  • 7-day Main River cruise – from Cologne to Passau via Frankfurt, Wertheim, Würzburg, Schweinfurt, Haßfurt, Nuremberg, and Regensburg
  • 7-day Main River cruise – from Frankfurt to Passau via Wertheim, Würzburg (overnight), Schweinfurt, Haßfurt, Nuremberg, and Regensburg
  • 7-day Danube River cruise from Austria – round-trip from Engelhartszell to Budapest, Kalocsa, Mohács, Belgrade, Mohács, Bratislava, Vienna, Krems, cruising Wachau Valley, and Melk
  • 7-day Danube River cruise – round-trip from Engelhartszell to Vienna (overnight), Esztergom, Budapest (overnight), Bratislava, Krems, Wachau Valley cruising, and Melk
  • 10-day Danube cruise from Austria to Romania – from Engelhartszell to Oltenita, visiting Wachau Valley, Vienna, Budapest, Mohács, Belgrade, Giurgiu, Oltenita, Tulcea (overnight), Sulina, and Brăila
  • 10-day Danube cruise – round-trip from Engelhartszell to Budapest, Kalocsa, Mohács, Belgrade, Mohács, Bratislava, Vienna, Krems, Wachau Valley cruising, and Melk
  • 11-day Danube cruise from Romania to Austria – from Oltenita to Engelhartszell, visiting Tulcea (overnight), Sulina, Fetești, Oltenita, Ruse (overnight), Belgrade, Novi Sad, Mohács, Budapest, Vienna, Krems, Wachau Valley cruising, and Melk

River Cruise Itinerary Ports

Below is a list of A-Rosa Silva’s ports of call and the visited countries:

  • Germany – Cologne, Koblenz, Main-Danube Canal, Loreley Rock, Mannheim, Schweinfurt, Speyer, Kehl (Strasbourg), Haßfurt, Mainz, Düsseldorf, Worms, Regensburg, Nuremberg, Bamberg, Würzburg, Wertheim, Frankfurt, Passau
  • The Netherlands – Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Terneuzen, IJsselmeer, Hoorn, Arnhem, Nijmegen, Dutch Delta, Westerschelde
  • Belgium – Antwerp, Ghent, Terneuzen
  • Austria – Vienna, Melk, Krems, Engelhartszell, Wachau Valley
  • Hungary – Budapest, Mohács, Kalocsa, Esztergom
  • Slovakia – Bratislava
  • Romania – Danube Delta, Galați, Tulcea, Sulina, Fetești, Oltenita, Giurgiu (for Bucharest), Brăila
  • Bulgaria – Ruse
  • Serbia – Belgrade, Iron Gates, Novi Sad
  • Ukraine – Danube Delta (Vylkove, Izmail)

A-Rosa Silva shore excursions are typically themed around food and wine, cultural and historical tours (museums, architecture, old towns), and various sports and leisure activities.

Arosa Silva Wiki

As the first of the line’s two newest vessels, the A-Rosa Silva river cruise ship belongs to the same class as A-Rosa Flora (launched in 2014). Each of these innovative riverboats is powered by four energy-efficient "Volvo Penta" diesel engines (model D12-450MH) with a total output of 1320 kW / 1800 HP. The propulsion system includes two auxiliary diesel generators and one additional diesel generator for in-port operations. The ship features "Schottel" propulsion, including one bow thruster (type SPJ 82) and four rudder propellers (type STP 200 with twin propellers). For navigating under low bridges, the wheelhouse/bridge and top deck awnings can be lowered.

A-Rosa Silva also offers complimentary bicycles for use during land tours and excursions at each visited port.

The ship was launched on July 2, 2012, and christened in Amsterdam (Holland) by Mrs. Sonja Dreisow, wife of Jörg Dreisow—Managing Director of A-Rosa’s majority shareholder, Waterland Private Equity Investments BV, an independent investment group.
